newsitem.title: LITHUANIA: EXPORT PROMOTION PLAN TO START IN APRIL.
newsitem.headline: EXPORT PROMOTION PLAN TO START IN APRIL.

text.p: Lithuanian Prime Minister Gediminas Vagnorius said on Thursday that the government's export-promotion and credit programme would begin in April.
Under the programme, unveiled earlier this year, the government plans to provide guarantees to banks for loans given to export-oriented companies.
It has set aside 45 million litas in the 1997 budget to cover the programme.
"The mechanism should be ready in three weeks, and both smaller and bigger industrial companies should be ready to make use of it in April," Vagnorius said at a news conference.
Boosting exports was a key plank in the government's platform during last fall's election campaign.
